content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 27 vacancies are available - 1 for Full Time Specialist (FTS) - Anaesthesiology, 1 for Full Time / Part Time Specialist (FTS/PTS) - Pathology, 1 for Full Time / Part Time Specialist (FTS/PTS) - Dermatology, 1 for Full Time / Part Time Specialist (FTS/PTS) - ENT, 1 for Full Time Specialist (FTS) - Eye, 1 for Full Time Specialist (FTS) - Medicine, 1 for Full Time Specialist (FTS) - Obstetrics & Gynaecology, 1 for Full Time / Part Time Specialist (FTS/PTS) - Orthopaedics, 1 for Full Time / Part Time Specialist (FTS/PTS) - Paediatrics, 1 for Full Time / Part Time Specialist (FTS/PTS) - Radiology, 1 for Full Time Specialist (FTS) - Surgery, 1 for Full Time / Part Time Specialist (FTS/PTS) - Psychiatry, 1 for Senior Resident (SR) - Anaesthesiology, 1 for Senior Resident (SR) - Dermatology, 2 for Senior Resident (SR) - Medicine, 2 for Senior Resident (SR) - Obstetrics & Gynaecology, 1 for Senior Resident (SR) - Biochemistry, 1 for Senior Resident (SR) - Eye, 1 for Senior Resident (SR) - Orthopaedics, 1 for Senior Resident (SR) - Paediatrics, 1 for Senior Resident (SR) - Surgery, 2 for Senior Resident (SR) - Accident & Emergency (A&E), 1 for Senior Resident (SR) against GDMO - Eye, 1 for Senior Resident (SR) against GDMO - Orthopaedics, 1 for Senior Resident (SR) against GDMO - Paediatrics, and 1 for Senior Resident (SR) against GDMO - Surgery.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: The primary walk-in interview date is 13th August 2026. However, for vacant posts, interviews may also be conducted on the 2nd and 4th Thursday of every month.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by ESIC?
faq.answer: ESIC has announced a total of 27 vacancies for Full Time Specialist (FTS), Part Time Specialist (PTS), and Senior Resident posts.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum qualifications required for these ESIC posts?
faq.answer: For Specialist posts, a PG Degree/Diploma in the concerned specialty is required with specific years of experience. For Senior Resident posts, a PG Degree or PG Diploma in the concerned specialty is necessary.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this ESIC recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the ESIC posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 69 years. Age relaxation for reserved categories will be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for the ESIC vacancies?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attend a walk-in interview with all required original documents and self-attested copies at the specified ESIC office.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the ESIC Specialist and Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 1,35,129/- per month, depending on the specific post (FTS/PTS) and specialty.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the ESIC office in Ankleshwar, Gujarat (Pincode: 393002).

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original and self-attested photocopies of ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on a Walk-in Interview.
